purpose: Real release progress and requested preparation reminders, for the existing authorized user inbox.

zh-Hans.title: 官网构建完成
zh-Hans.subtitle: 网站发布
zh-Hans.body: PushNow 官网已生成 127 个页面。Astro 检查通过：0 个错误、0 个警告。六语言使用指南和常见问题已纳入本次构建。

en.title: Website build completed
en.subtitle: Website release
en.body: The PushNow website build generated 127 pages. Astro checks passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings. This build includes guides and FAQs in six languages.

zh-Hans.title: 六语言订阅资料已更新
zh-Hans.subtitle: App Store 准备
zh-Hans.body: 4 个订阅商品和会员分组已补齐英文、简体中文、日文、韩文、西班牙文和德文资料。商品名称已统一为 PushNow；现有月付价格保持不变。

en.title: Store details updated in six languages
en.subtitle: App Store preparation
en.body: All four subscriptions and the membership group now have English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and German details. Names use PushNow; existing monthly prices are unchanged.

zh-Hans.title: 服务健康检查通过
zh-Hans.subtitle: 服务状态
zh-Hans.body: PushNow 正式服务与独立测试服务的健康检查均已通过。测试账号可以正常登录，正式环境会拒绝测试环境的身份凭据。详细检查结果已归档。

en.title: Service health checks passed
en.subtitle: Service status
en.body: Health checks passed for both the live PushNow service and its separate test service. Test account sign-in works, and the live service rejects test credentials. The verification report is ready to review.

messages.evidence: Current user request: complete localization, then capture Chinese and English screens on the physical device.

zh-Hans.title: 提醒：检查中文版界面
zh-Hans.subtitle: 我的提醒
zh-Hans.body: 现在检查中文收件箱、消息详情和会员页面。确认所有按钮、筛选标签和日期都使用中文，再继续准备英文版本。

en.title: Reminder: review the English interface
en.subtitle: My reminders
en.body: Review the inbox, message details and membership page in English. Check buttons, filters and dates before preparing the final screenshots.
